entries.name: Icon (2026-08 set)
entries.note: Twenty-nine glyphs in a 20x20 frame, one variant axis (`Icon`) — Lucide-traced strokes, plus four filled social brand marks (`2177:1603`, `2177:1605`, `2177:1607`, `2177:1609`) that route nowhere. Three of the strokes are the curated set a button's `icon` knob picks from (#151) — arrow-right (2177:1559), external-link (2177:1585), chevron-down (2177:1567) — vendored as inline SVG rather than installed (ADR 0009). A change to one of those three routes to `button-icons.tsx`; a change to the other twenty-six routes nowhere yet.

entries.name: Go birds.
entries.note: Easter egg, instanced beside the Footer's copyright line. Not a component in code: the string is Site Settings' `copyrightNote` and the set's `State=Hover` is a `hover:` utility on it (#87). The set's eagle vector draws nothing in that instance and is not exported.

entries.name: Interior Hero
entries.note: The ink hero on every interior and collection frame: Device = Desktop (`2101:828`) | Mobile (`2107:1042`), #0A0A0B, eyebrow + h2 + standfirst. `CollectionHero`'s `interior` variant is built to it. Tracked from 2026-08-16 alongside `CTA` and `Blog` — the three page-level sets the component map had never carried.

entries.name: Blog
entries.note: The insight band on Home and the insight index: Property 1 = Default (`2134:1302`, 1440×866) | Mobile (`2204:1145`, 402×1372), bone, 48px gap. Its axis is the unnamed `Property 1` where the other two page sets use `Device`; the values still read Desktop/Mobile, so it is one axis, not a second vocabulary. `CarouselTrack` already reads the mobile variant. Tracked from 2026-08-16.

entries.name: Case Study Card
entries.note: The case-study card as a set at last: 1246 × 550 filling a 1248 column, radius 32, padding 64 uniform, space-between over a gap floor of 66 — a 180 × 80 logo holder above a 1118 content row that is 559 of text beside 559 of deadspace, holding an eyebrow (18/24 bold, red #C90E00), a 24/34 narrative, a stat row and a white `Button / Solid`. The /work index instances it three times (`2107:1094`–`1096`) and the case-study detail's next-project band once (`2250:1564`); at 402 the stack `2975:8428` overrides the padding to 24 side / 64 top-and-bottom. Its axis — the `Variant` property, Caron | Ironman | Vertex — is which client the demo shows, so it maps to no `cva` key. The gen-1 sets `264:573` / `1393:3025` never became canonical; this one did. Tracked from 2026-08-24 (#302), internals read from the node tree at file version 2391349966960467923 (#314); the renderer draws all of it since #319.
